metadata.description: Clean-room driver-porting skills. Their output is never published; install driver-lab alongside.

plugins.name: cleanroom-skills
plugins.description: The clean-room method: cleanroom-investigator (facts from encumbered source, in original words, with a leak scanner), cleanroom-spec (a verified peripheral spec and a private provenance record), cleanroom-verifier (accuracy re-checks and verification records behind the wall), and cleanroom-implementer (hooks, sandbox and audits that keep the implementing agent away from the source). Needs driver-lab's driver-porting plugin installed alongside.
